description: Work with your Geotab fleet: vehicles and where they are, trips, GPS history, engine readings and fault codes, rule violations, zones, drivers' hours and messages to drivers.

geotab_new_driver_message_trigger.description: Runs for each text message sent from a vehicle, such as a driver's reply in Geotab Drive. Messages before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every minute or less often, as your workspace plan allows.

output.content_type: The kind of message, such as Normal or CannedResponse.
output.message: What the driver wrote or picked.
output.reply_to_message_id: The id of the message it replies to, if any.
output.vehicle_id: The vehicle's Geotab id, for the vehicle steps.

parameters.description: Only this vehicle. Leave blank for every vehicle.
parameters.name: vehicle_id

geotab_new_exception_event_trigger.description: Runs for each exception event: a vehicle breaking one of your MyGeotab rules, such as speeding, harsh braking or leaving a zone after hours. Violations before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every minute or less often, as your workspace plan allows.

output.distance_km: How far the vehicle went during it, in kilometers.
output.driver_id: The driver's Geotab id, blank when no driver was identified.
output.duration: How long it lasted, such as 00:01:10.
output.ended_at: When it ended, as far as Geotab knew then.
output.rule_name: The rule's name, such as Speeding.
output.vehicle_id: The vehicle's Geotab id, for the vehicle steps.

parameters.description: Only violations of this rule. Leave blank for every rule.
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.description: Only this vehicle. Leave blank for every vehicle.
parameters.name: vehicle_id

geotab_new_fault_trigger.description: Runs for each engine or device fault code a vehicle reports, with the fault's name, code, state and warning lamps. Faults reported before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every minute or less often, as your workspace plan allows.

output.amber_warning_lamp: Whether the amber warning lamp is on.
output.controller_id: The id of the part of the vehicle that reported it.
output.diagnostic_id: The fault's diagnostic id in Geotab.
output.diagnostic_name: What the fault is, such as Engine misfire detected.
output.malfunction_lamp: Whether the malfunction lamp is on.
output.red_stop_lamp: Whether the red stop lamp is on.
output.vehicle_id: The vehicle's Geotab id, for the vehicle steps.

parameters.description: Only this vehicle. Leave blank for every vehicle.
parameters.name: vehicle_id

geotab_new_trip_trigger.description: Runs for each trip a vehicle finishes, with its start, stop, distance, speeds and where it ended. Trips finished before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every minute or less often, as your workspace plan allows.

output.average_speed_kmh: Its average speed while driving, in km/h.
output.distance_km: How far it went, in kilometers.
output.driver_id: The driver's Geotab id, blank when no driver was identified.
output.driving_duration: How long it drove, such as 00:32:30.
output.next_trip_start: When its next trip started, once known.
output.stop_duration: How long it then stood, such as 00:37:30.
output.vehicle_id: The vehicle's Geotab id, for the vehicle steps.

parameters.description: Only this vehicle. Leave blank for every vehicle.
parameters.name: vehicle_id

parameters.description: Only trips by this driver. Leave blank for every driver.
parameters.name: driver_id

geotab_new_vehicle_trigger.description: Runs for each vehicle (GO device) added to the MyGeotab database. Vehicles already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every minute or less often, as your workspace plan allows.

output.device_type: The kind of device, such as GO9.
output.name: The vehicle's name in MyGeotab.
output.vehicle_id: The vehicle's Geotab id, for the vehicle steps.
output.vin: Its vehicle identification number, if known.
